# Programming / Python

Write, review and teach idiomatic modern Python for AI engineers: idioms, comprehensions, type hints, dataclasses, exception design, context managers, concurrency (asyncio, threads, processes, the GIL, deadlocks, Trio/AnyIO) and beginner tutoring.
